_about: Special days (see EventCalendar). holidays: a fixed date as "MM-DD", or "easter" (worked out for each year). Chefs are asked their birthday on their first day (birthday_question); a regular's birthday is the "birthday" field in their character file. On launch, a banner says what today is (banner_seconds on screen). {player} and {name} fill in. Real event content comes later.

birthday_question.title: Before we open
birthday_question.ask_month: {player}, when's your birthday? So the restaurant can celebrate.
